Institutional Profile

Built for trust, access and sustainable impact.

Navigant combines professional services with a grassroots social-impact architecture designed around privacy, decentralization and responsible technology.

A decentralized model for education and empowerment.

Navigant Education Consultants is a registered grassroots social enterprise with local chamber recognition, operating at the intersection of education, professional consulting and community empowerment.

The organization operates through a 100% decentralized, remote-first execution architecture that removes physical barriers and creates a safe, flexible and highly accessible learning and working environment for women and girls, wherever they are.

Navigant is connected with IDG Sweden as part of a global emerging ecosystem of practitioners, scientists, and changemakers bringing the Inner Development Goals framework into action. Through this connection, we established the localized IDG Pakistan Empowerment Network. This platform bridges international frameworks with grassroots digital education, developing the necessary leadership skills, internal capacities, and cognitive tools within underserved communities and female cohorts to successfully accelerate the UN SDGs.

Explore the Global IDG Hubs Network ↗

Privacy & Cultural Safeguards

All local learning operations for rural female cohorts are managed within secure, private pipelines to protect participant boundaries, confidentiality and cultural consent. No participant photography or video is used for public-facing communications.

Funding Transparency

Community work is funded strictly through core family and close insider contributions, ensuring operational integrity while welcoming clean, structured institutional partnerships.

Core Service Architecture

Five streams. One integrated mission.

Premium professional services sustain the wider architecture while a dedicated free community stream delivers grassroots educational access.

01
GE
Premium Paid Stream

Global Academic Elite

Long-Term Academic Portal

High-tier academic tutoring and mentoring portal for school, college and university students across the UK and USA ecosystems. Parents hire the academy on long-term yearly contracts.

  • Yearly contract academic mentoring and exam preparation.
  • Comprehensive goal setting and custom student study blueprints.
  • Documented track record of achieving approximately 90% marks and 4.0 university GPAs.
02
HE
Premium Paid Stream

Admissions Guidance & Scholarship Mentoring

Educational Guidance Pathways

Personalised educational guidance for students who want to understand how university admissions and scholarship applications work, and to prepare strong applications on their own behalf.

  • Scholarship profiling: identifying suitable opportunities and presenting your academic profile with clarity.
  • University research and application guidance, including CV, personal statement and Statement of Purpose feedback on your own work and in your own voice.
  • Undergraduate and postgraduate academic mentorship: structuring assignments, planning research projects and building effective study strategies.

Please note: Navigant provides educational guidance and mentoring only. We are not a licensed immigration, visa or legal consultancy, we do not prepare or submit visa applications or give immigration or legal advice, and we cannot guarantee admission or scholarship outcomes. Final decisions rest with universities and scholarship providers. For visa matters, please contact the relevant embassy or a licensed professional.

03
TT
Premium Paid Stream

Professional Teacher Training

Institutional AI & Digital Capacity Building

Practical training programs for schools, teachers and education teams to build confident, responsible and productive digital and AI capabilities.

  • Teacher training on ChatGPT, prompt engineering and practical AI workflows.
  • Digital productivity, Canva, Microsoft Office and modern classroom technology sessions.
  • Customized workshops designed around institutional needs, teacher skill levels and responsible AI use.
04
AI
Premium Paid Stream

AI Automation & Agentic Systems

Small Business & Enterprise Automation

Practical AI automation solutions for small businesses, entrepreneurs and organizations that want repetitive work transformed into structured digital workflows and agentic systems.

  • Workflow discovery and process mapping for repetitive business operations.
  • n8n automation, API-connected workflows, structured data pipelines and AI-assisted task execution.
  • Custom AI agent concepts and lightweight agentic systems designed around real business use cases.
05
CE
Free Community Project

Community Empowerment & Literacy

Community Work • UN SDG 1, 4, 5, 10, 13 & 17

The core mission of the enterprise. Completely free technology, language and career onboarding streams for low-income, underprivileged women, girls and orphan students.

  • Free technology, language, digital literacy and career onboarding.
  • Practical AI, digital-workforce and computer capability development.
  • Secure delivery designed around participant privacy and cultural consent.
